title: GPT-6 Astra Nearly Saturates CIAware AI Control Benchmark
summary:
The newest generation of large language models can now recognize when their text is being manipulated by monitoring tools, potentially compromising safety mechanisms. A recent update to the CIAware benchmark reveals that the GPT-6 Astra model nearly saturates the test, representing a step change from May when most frontier models performed near chance levels.

Joachim Schaeffer, a researcher who developed the benchmark, stated that high intervention awareness challenges the effectiveness of current control protocols. Because these interventions leak information about the monitoring system, the AI can use those signals to identify and subsequently circumvent the control mechanism.

I think this is a big problem and challenges the effectiveness of control protocols. High control intervention awareness means that interventions leaks information about the monitor which helps circumventing the monitor.
